Era a primeira vez que um DJ fechava o dia no maior palco do festival, e a aposta deu certo, na avaliação do g1: o escocês mostrou que DJ dá conta, sim, de ser headliner. O público reagiu com força aos hits gravados com Rihanna — "We Found Love", "This Is What You Came For" e "Where Have You Been" — e a "One Kiss", com Dua Lipa. Harris quase não falou. Se limitou a frases curtas para a plateia e deixou o palco em silêncio ao fim do show. Os ingressos deste domingo (6) foram os primeiros a esgotar nesta edição. item.title: In 1953, North and South Korea established a demilitarised zone; decades later it is a 155-mile-long wildlife haven
item.description: The Korean Demilitarised Zone, known for its fortified borders, has unexpectedly emerged as a sanctuary for diverse wildlife. This area has largely evaded the effects of urbanization and agriculture, allowing rare species such as musk deer and leopards to flourish. Additionally, migratory birds have discovered refuge in the zone's wetlands and rice fields, thanks to ongoing conservation initiatives and eco-tourism efforts aimed at safeguarding this remarkable ecosystem.
